verdict.rationale: Webhook event subscription is a fair question for a cloud data platform, but the pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Streams (change tracking queried inside Snowflake) and Snowpipe (inbound loading) are building blocks or adjacent features. The 'notification integrations for cost anomaly alerts' release note never says those notifications are webhooks a programmatic consumer can receive, so none of this earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
